title: Talmud Torah vs. Berit Milah

chapters.title: The principle of HaOsek BaMitzvah
chapters.about: Exemption from mitzvot while engaged in another

summary: Rabbi Harari examines whether one should interrupt their Torah study to attend a Berit Milah or its associated Se'udah. He discusses the principle of HaOsek BaMitzvah Patur Min HaMitzvah and the specific status of Talmud Torah, ultimately suggesting that one should assess whether their presence is truly expected or if they can fulfill the mitzvah in other ways.
questions: Is it permitted to stop studying Torah to attend a Berit Milah?
Does the principle of being exempt from other mitzvot while performing one apply to Torah study?
What does it mean to be a Ben Adam Mehugan in the context of attending a celebration?
Is it considered a failure to miss a Se'udah Shel Mitzvah?
How should a student or a working person decide if their presence at a simcha is required?
